creator.descr: account with unrestricted bootstrap authority while the Guild is in draft

pluginSetLocked.descr: whether plugin additions and removals are permanently disabled

proposalActionLimit.descr: maximum number of actions in one proposal

removeAllowancesProposalSettings.descr: settings for removing ARC-58 escrow allowances

removeExecutionProposalSettings.descr: settings for removing ARC-58 execution keys

reserved.descr:
Proposer prepayments held in free balance for proposals that have not reached a terminal
outcome. Proposal boxes are already locked as minimum balance and are therefore excluded.

toggleEscrowLockProposalSettings.descr: settings for locking, unlocking, and reclaiming ARC-58 escrows

updateGuildProposalSettings.descr: settings for changing the Guild itself

upgradeAppProposalSettings.descr: settings for Guild or managed application upgrades

walletFactory.descr: factory used to create and update the ARC-58 wallet

contract.name: Guild
contract.desc:
Generic proposal and ARC-58 execution kernel. Membership, voting, vote
storage, and final resolution live in the permanently paired consensus app.

Funds model: the Guild application account only ever holds its own minimum
balance plus proposer prepayments for proposals that have not reached a
terminal outcome (`reserved`). Everything else is returned to whoever paid it
or forwarded to the treasury, the Guild's ARC-58 wallet.

methods.name: consensusConfigurationMbr
methods.desc: Return the MBR required by the paired consensus implementation for an opaque draft configuration.

methods.name: configureConsensus
methods.desc: Forward opaque draft configuration to the paired consensus implementation.

methods.name: setup
methods.desc: Create the Guild's ARC-58 wallet through its configured wallet factory.

methods.name: setProposalSettings
methods.desc: Update one action class's proposal settings while the Guild remains in draft.

methods.name: setConsensusActionSettings
methods.desc: Attach proposal settings to one opaque consensus action code while the Guild remains in draft.

methods.name: setProposalActionLimit
methods.desc: Update the maximum proposal action count while the Guild remains in draft.

methods.name: lockPluginSet
methods.desc: Permanently prevent this Guild from adding or removing ARC-58 plugins.

methods.name: partiallyInitialize
methods.desc: End creator control while allowing consensus to attach the ARC-58 wallet later.

methods.name: initialize
methods.desc: End creator control and require the Guild's ARC-58 wallet to be configured.

methods.name: newProposal
methods.desc: Create a proposal after the paired consensus app verifies proposer power.

methods.name: editProposal
methods.desc: Edit a draft proposal without adding funding.

methods.name: editProposalWithPayment
methods.desc: Edit a draft proposal and fund its increased storage, ballot MBR, or action fees.

methods.name: deleteProposal
methods.desc:
Delete a never-submitted draft or any bootstrap proposal as its creator.

Drafts refund the full prepayment; bootstrap proposals, which the Guild funded from
creator-provided balance, refund the storage they release.

methods.name: submitProposal
methods.desc: Move a proposal created under Guild consensus from draft to voting.

methods.name: voteProposal
methods.desc:
Vote through the Guild while its consensus app calculates and stores the result. Voting again changes
the vote; only a first vote pays for its receipt (see `voteCost`).

methods.name: finalizeProposal
methods.desc: Resolve the proposal using the result returned by the paired consensus app.

methods.name: cleanupProposalConsensus
methods.desc:
Reclaim terminal consensus boxes without deleting the historical Guild proposal.

Every listed voter recovers their own vote receipt; the ballot storage returns to the proposer.
Approved ballots stay until execution or cancellation, since policies read the approving
ballot while applying consensus actions.

methods.name: cancelProposal
methods.desc:
Abandon an approved proposal that has not executed, refunding its execution reserve.

Approved proposals never expire, and state changes after approval can leave one permanently
unexecutable; cancellation is the proposer's way to recover the reserve they prepaid.

methods.name: executeProposal
methods.desc: Execute every action in an approved proposal.

methods.name: update
methods.desc: Active upgrades consume a voted transaction-group commitment, including exact program bytes and version.

methods.name: sweep
methods.desc:
Forward every microALGO that is not the Guild's own storage or a proposer's reserve to the treasury.

Anyone may call this once the Guild is active; in draft only the creator may, since the
creator funds draft storage from this balance.

methods.name: setupCost
methods.desc: Return the funding required to create the Guild's ARC-58 wallet.

methods.name: proposalCost
methods.desc: Return proposal cost and the strictest consensus settings among all actions.

methods.name: getProposal
methods.desc: Return a proposal by ID.

methods.name: getBallot
methods.desc: Return the consensus ballot for a Guild proposal.

methods.name: mustGetExecution
methods.desc: Return proposal metadata associated with an ARC-58 execution key.

methods.name: getConsensusActionSettings
methods.desc: Return the settings that govern one opaque consensus action code.

methods.name: voteCost
methods.desc: What `voter`'s next vote on the proposal pays: a first vote funds its receipt; changing a vote is free.

methods.name: voteMbr
methods.desc: Return the minimum-balance payment required to store one vote.

methods.name: sweepable
methods.desc: Return the balance sweep() would forward to the treasury right now.

methods.name: canChangePluginSet
methods.desc: Return whether proposals may still add or remove wallet plugins.
